verification_instructions: Run all three gates in /Users/paulbrown/Code/etrade-local-proxy: (1) `cargo build` completes with no errors (AC-1); (2) `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` produces zero warnings — this exact command enforces AC-2, turning warnings into errors at invocation rather than via a crate-level #![deny(warnings)]; (3) `cargo test` passes all unit, proptest, and integration tests (AC-3). contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md exists. The authoritative convention source is .kiro/steering/rust-functional-style.md (inclusion: always): pure functional core / thin imperative shell; errors as values via per-module #[non_exhaustive] thiserror enums with #[from], anyhow ONLY in main; no unwrap/expect outside genuinely-unreachable documented cases; typestate over boolean flags; newtypes over bare primitives; inject clock/nonce/RNG so the core is deterministic; combinators/iterators over manual loops where clearer; immutable by default with scoped mut; property tests (proptest) for the pure core where properties hold, example-based + integration tests for edge cases and the shell. The design at .agents/tasks/design.md is LOCKED and authoritative for module layout, function signatures, crate stack, and error hierarchy — do NOT re-decide architecture.
key_patterns: core/ tree is PURE: no tokio/axum/reqwest/rustls/std::env/std::io references; unit- and property-testable with plain values. shell/ tree owns all effects. The OAuth signing domain is modeled around the WORK PERFORMED, not the URL: three distinct typed legs SigningInput::{RequestToken, AccessToken, Resource}, each carrying exactly the fields its leg admits (the token secret travels inside the leg); all three feed ONE signature_base_string builder and ONE authorization_header builder, both derived from the same OauthParams.as_pairs(), so base string and header cannot diverge and oauth_token is never emitted empty. admit(method, path) is a TOTAL pure function (verb-first GET-only check, then /etrade-api/v1/accounts prefix with query preserved). Loopback bind is a code constant Ipv4Addr::LOCALHOST, never from data. Auth lifecycle is a consuming typestate (Unauthorized -> Authorized owning the token); shared runtime state is Arc<std::sync::RwLock<AuthPhase>> with the guard never held across .await. Secrets use secrecy::SecretString (redacting Debug, no Display, zeroize on drop); the single source-level expose_secret() site is core::oauth::sign::signing_key. Injected Clock/NonceSource generator traits draw a FRESH (nonce, timestamp) immediately before signing each OAuth leg and each proxied request.
